source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: When an OAuth-only selection suppresses passwords, the QR pane saves the checkbox's prior choice in dataset.wasChecked, clears checked and disables it. When password export becomes relevant again, it restores the choice using === "true" and deletes the saved state. dataset values are strings; testing the string "false" as a boolean would restore the wrong choice. The submit handler reads checked, so hidden stale state must not carry passwords into export. The current browser test covers checked restoration, but not a separate initially-unchecked restoration cycle.
title: Round-trip QR checkbox state through dataset as a string
